item.text:
**Bottom line:** mixed, leaning negative. Tinubu did make some public concessions in 2024 and later ordered a limited corrective probe, but the stronger pattern is false or inflated economic messaging, selective disclosure of tradeoffs, and punitive legal framing against protesters and journalists.

**Positive / mitigating evidence**

| Direction | Title | Publisher | Date | Claim-level summary | QIDs | URL |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| + | Tinubu speaks on economic reforms, new minimum wage in Democracy Day speech | TheCable | 2024-06-12 | Tinubu publicly acknowledged that reforms had created hardship and said his government negotiated with labour rather than relying on arrests or repression. | 7B.8, 7B.1 | https://www.thecable.ng/full-text-tinubu-speaks-on-economic-reforms-new-minimum-wage-in-democracy-day-speech/ |
| + | Tinubu seeks dialogue with protesters, asks them to suspend demonstrations | TheCable | 2024-08-04 | He asked protesters to pause demonstrations “to create room for dialogue” and said he had heard them “loud and clear.” | 7B.8, 7B.7 | https://www.thecable.ng/breaking-tinubu-asks-protesters-to-suspend-demonstrations-seeks-dialogue/ |
| + | Tinubu orders probe of security agents involved in arrest, detention of minors | TheCable | 2024-11-04 | After backlash, Tinubu ordered an investigation into the arrest and treatment of minors detained over the protests and directed their release. | 7B.8, 7B.7 | https://www.thecable.ng/tinubu-orders-probe-of-security-agents-involved-in-arrest-detention-of-minors/ |
| + | Nigeria: Freedom on the Net 2024 | Freedom House | 2024 | Freedom House reported no nationwide internet shutdowns in 2024, which is weak positive evidence against blanket information suppression. | 7B.8, 7B.7 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/nigeria/freedom-net/2024 |

**Negative evidence**

| Direction | Title | Publisher | Date | Claim-level summary | QIDs | URL |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| - | Fact-checking president Tinubu's claims about Nigeria's economic successes in his Independence Day speech | Africa Check | 2024-10-03 | Africa Check found Tinubu’s claims about $30 billion in FDI and a $33 billion inherited reserve were wrong; the reserve figure was closer to $35 billion and the FDI claim was unsupported. | 7B.8, 7B.1 | https://africacheck.org/fact-checks/reports/fact-checking-president-tinubus-claims-about-nigerias-economic-successes-his |
| - | Nigeria: Protesters Charged with Treason | Human Rights Watch | 2024-09-06 | HRW said authorities charged protesters with treason, held many in prolonged detention, and framed dissent as a security threat rather than ordinary political contention. | 7B.8, 7B.7 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/09/06/nigeria-protesters-charged-treason |
| - | Nigeria has detained journalist who reported on corruption in widening crackdown | Reuters via GPB | 2024-05-09 | Reuters reported Daniel Ojukwu was detained under the Cybercrime Act after a corruption story, which looks like punishment for investigative reporting. | 7B.8, 7B.7 | https://www.gpb.org/news/2024/05/09/nigeria-has-detained-journalist-who-reported-on-corruption-in-widening-crackdown |
| - | Nigeria police charge 4 journalists with cybercrimes for corruption reporting | Committee to Protect Journalists | 2024-10-03 | CPJ reported four journalists were charged under the Cybercrimes Act despite February reforms, showing continued legal pressure on scrutiny. | 7B.8, 7B.7 | https://cpj.org/2024/10/nigeria-police-charge-4-journalists-with-cybercrimes-for-corruption-reporting/ |
| - | Nigeria considers tough penalties for subversive acts under proposed law | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-08-14 | Reuters reported a Counter Subversion Bill criticized as a crackdown on dissent after the protests; the proposal itself signaled a punitive information climate. | 7B.8, 7B.7 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/nigeria-considers-tough-penalties-for-subversive-acts-under-proposed-law-3571782 |

**Search gap**
- I did not find public 2024 evidence of a transparent asset-declaration release, campaign-finance disclosure, or a formal, standing mechanism showing Tinubu consistently corrected false macro claims without external fact-checking pressure.
- The strongest pro-side evidence is reactive, not proactive: acknowledgment of hardship, a call for dialogue, and a late probe after abuse became visible.
- The strongest anti-side evidence is concrete and repeated: inflated economic claims, protest criminalization, and legal pressure on journalists.
